summary: Sections: add, remove, move, resize and set the sections of a piece version's request.

commands.name: section.insert
commands.summary: Add a section to a piece's request after or before another

params.name: id
params.help: The id of the new section.

params.name: after
params.help: The id of the section it follows.

params.name: before
params.help: The id of the section it precedes.

params.name: bars
params.help: Its length in bars.

params.name: beats
params.help: Its length in beats.

params.name: role
params.help: Its part of the piece (default body).

params.name: letter
params.help: Its letter.

params.name: function
params.help: Its function.

params.name: cadence
params.help: The cadence it ends in.

params.name: pickup
params.help: The beats of anacrusis before it, as 1 or 1/2.

params.name: fill
params.help: How it is filled.

params.name: region
params.help: Its region: a key or a relation to an anchor, written as member lines.

params.name: harmony
params.help: Its harmony, as the piece request gives it.

params.name: note
params.help: The version note (default: what the command did).

commands.reply: The new version number and the ids of the sections in order.
commands.example: section.insert item:pce-2c8d54834a9c499f@v2 after s0 id T0 bars 4 role body letter T function transition

commands.name: section.delete
commands.summary: Remove a section from a piece's request

params.name: id
params.help: The id of the section.

params.name: note
params.help: The version note (default: what the command did).

commands.reply: The new version number and the ids of the sections in order.

commands.name: section.move
commands.summary: Move a section after or before another

params.name: id
params.help: The id of the section to move.

params.name: after
params.help: The id of the section it follows.

params.name: before
params.help: The id of the section it precedes.

params.name: note
params.help: The version note (default: what the command did).

commands.reply: The new version number and the ids of the sections in order.
commands.example: section.move item:pce-2c8d54834a9c499f@v2 id T0 after s0

commands.name: section.resize
commands.summary: Change the length of a section

params.name: id
params.help: The id of the section.

params.name: bars
params.help: Its new length in bars.

params.name: beats
params.help: Its new length in beats.

params.name: note
params.help: The version note (default: what the command did).

commands.reply: The new version number and the ids of the sections in order.

commands.name: section.set
commands.summary: Change the role, letter, function, cadence, pickup, fill, region or harmony

params.name: id
params.help: The id of the section.

params.name: role
params.help: Its part of the piece.

params.name: letter
params.help: Its letter.

params.name: function
params.help: Its function, or none to remove it.

params.name: cadence
params.help: The cadence it ends in, or none to remove it.

params.name: pickup
params.help: The beats of anacrusis before it.

params.name: fill
params.help: How it is filled.

params.name: region
params.help: Its region, written as member lines, or the word home to remove it.

params.name: harmony
params.help: Its harmony as the piece request gives it, or the word none to remove it.

params.name: note
params.help: The version note (default: what the command did).

commands.reply: The new version number and the ids of the sections in order.
commands.example:
section.set item:pce-2c8d54834a9c499f@v2 id s0 cadence PAC letter A
  region relation omt.relation.dominant anchor home
